newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar ends flat as cenbank intervenes.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar ends flat as cenbank intervenes.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed flat at 470.75/471.75 per dollar after strong corporate dollar demand was met by Central Bank sales, traders said.
"It (the Central Bank) left the market with sufficient dollars so that no one was left wanting," said one trader.
Traders reported only mild interbank trade, a pattern expected to continue through the week.
"We don't expect much change in yields at the TEM auction tomorrow, so we don't see any abrupt movements in the foreign exchange market for the rest of the week," said one broker.
The Central Bank is due to auction 35 billion bolivars of TEM bills on Wednesday. TEMs are used as a benchmark for wider interest rates.
